The Rust side removes correctly; the caller kotlin/shop/Encoder.kt:14-18 returns early for frames over MAX_INLINE_BYTES (16384) without calling Native.close, so those handles (and their Vec<u8>) stay in FRAMES forever. Missing pairing: close on the bulk path. Not exercised by DLA in the rust worker (cdylib, no Rust driver; JVM driver Main.kt belongs to the jvm worker).
Frame.bytes is the per-entry payload owned by FRAMES (see rust/F2); it is retained only because its map entry is never removed on the bulk path. Not an independent holder.
